title: Acorn Addition
tagline: Combine two acorn stashes for a woodland feast.
howToPlay: Move the toys to tell the story. Make equal shares when sharing, then choose an answer. Three gentle difficulty settings. Ages 4–8. Learning: Concrete addition.

title: Animal Alphabet

title: Balloon Pop
tagline: Pop smiley, heart, bunny and star balloons over a sunny countryside!
howToPlay: Tap or click a balloon to pop it (or steer the pin with the arrow keys and press Space). Fill the bar to reach the next level and meet new balloons: golden balloons with a crown are worth 5, a star pops every balloon, and a rainbow makes baby balloons. Tap the sun, a sheep, a house, a tree, the windmill or the hot-air balloon for a surprise. Nothing is ever lost, so just keep popping!

title: Birdsong Tuner

howToPlay: Play both sounds, then choose the higher or lower one. Replay as often as you like. Three gentle difficulty settings. Ages 3–7. Learning: High and low sounds.

title: Breakfast Story

howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle your duck. Tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and BONK! Bubbles are worth 1, stars 3. 🎁 boxes make you giant, super fast or bouncy. Bonk a friend out of the water for a splash bonus. Nobody is ever out!

title: Bunny Bedtime

howToPlay: Tap the screen or press the space bar to hop. Tap again in the air for a flippy double hop! Munch carrots, hop over logs and pumpkins, and leap for the golden carrots on the way home.

Stack all the layers (or tap the candle button when you are done) and an animal friend comes for a birthday party: tap to help blow out the candles! Every new friend brings a new flavour. Open Recipe studio to build pictured flavour recipes from bottom to top and share equal slices fairly among two or three friends.
learning: Counting, ordered recipes and equal sharing

Missed one? It just swims off giggling and another comes along. Every catch goes into your 📖 book: can you find all 15?

howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to roll your animal's paint roller and colour the ground. Grab a 🪣 paint bucket for a big splash, roll through a 🌈 rainbow puddle to paint rainbow stripes, and 💧 water washes a little paint away. Roll over any colour to make it yours. When the time is up, look at the picture you made together: it is kept in My pictures by itself. Open Mix my colours to explore a simplified red/yellow/blue toy paint model, compare saved mixtures and create your own colour mosaic.
learning: Colour exploration, creative patterns and cooperation

Press the big red button to launch! Drag, or use the arrow keys, to steer and catch stars. Bigger boosters fly farther, and every new planet you visit unlocks new parts.
